Expose safe connection health and immutable per-run failure manifests: last contact, last validated success, backlog, drift and item counts. Bounded samples require current content rights; replay only failed items against the reviewed resolving mapping version while retaining original failures and excluding secrets/raw payloads/other tenant identities. Complete retained source obligation: Connection health displays last contact, last successful validated run, backlog, source drift and per item counts. Error details use safe field references and correlation IDs. A bounded diagnostic sample requires appropriate content rights. Never display tokens, unrestricted raw payloads or another tenant's source identity. Retrying requires the reviewed mapping version that resolved the issue.

current_code.reuse_note: Current imports pin source hashes and mappings, clear stale previews on edits and validate source columns/value roles; a persistent connector failure/replay catalogue remains additional work.
Fenced job manifests and safe error classes provide durable execution diagnostics patterns, not a complete connection health service.
Existing import mapping/preview/results UI can supply safe field-level diagnostic and replay presentation.

open_decisions: Which health states and bounded sample fields are safe for each role, and how long are original failure manifests retained?
How does a reviewed mapping version prove it resolves source drift and which failed-item identities remain stable across replay?

tasks.title: Define health projections and resolving-mapping replay contract
tasks.description: Proposed work: Specify last contact/validated success/backlog/drift/count fields, safe field references/correlation IDs, content-right gated sample bounds and retained failure identities.
acceptance_criteria: Health/error responses exclude credentials, unrestricted raw payloads and any other tenant's source identity.

acceptance_criteria: A renamed column failure can be diagnosed and retried with the resolving mapping while original failure data is retained unchanged.
